contradictions.what: Rep names Diane as final decider but never spoke to her, she was in no meetings, and all knowledge comes secondhand from Owen.
Rep says nothing could have been done, yet Owen said he needed a customer-specific number, which was never built.
Rep frames outcome as a freeze on everything, yet paper had been sent, implying a deal was close and stalled on finance approval.
Rep never engaged finance and thinks Diane was never told the cost, yet claims nothing could have been done.
No trigger or date existed, yet rep calls it timing and predicts it will return next year.
Finance asks began 'maybe a month' before the freeze; later 'about a month' between ask and freeze, consistent but hedged, with the ROI session never scheduled.
